description: Premises are not continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
applicability: Organizations requiring continuous monitoring of physical premises to detect and respond to unauthorized access attempts

metadata.detection_notes: Assess whether continuous monitoring systems (CCTV, motion sensors, alarm systems, security personnel) are deployed and actively monitored. Absence of surveillance systems, unmonitored cameras, or lack of 24/7 monitoring indicates this deficiency. Note: A.7.4 is new in ISO 27001:2022.
